The cast is exactly four fictional adult women, every one exactly age 21 and female-only: blonde Radiance, dark-haired Ellie, Black Alia, and brunette AI ECE. No other people. Freeze a synchronized couture pivot: Ellie deliberately steadies Radiance by forearm and shoulder, Radiance gives Alia one brief consensual cheek peck, and ECE answers with a clearly playful jealous lifted brow and silver-tipped hand-on-hip pose. Alia then reaches for ECE and closes all four into a warm reconciled shoulder-linked crescent. Suggest a slow stabilized lateral dolly into a shallow crescent arc entirely over the dry level promenade. CAMERA ROLL 72/100 - INTERMEDIATE FRAMING. Show all four women in one cohesive composition and crop strictly at the knees. Do not show lower legs or footwear. Keep the location broad, legible, and unmistakable. The protective steady, cheek peck, playful jealousy, and reconciliation must all read instantly within this exact crop. No props, leaf interaction, leaning, running, jumping, tripping, stumbles, falls, or unsafe motion.
